findings.description: `lambda value: value in list(items)` runs list() on the generator on every test call. The first call uses up the generator; every later call builds an empty list and returns False. The bug gets worse: the issue example now returns only the first matching document instead of the first two. The design said to materialise once at construction (`if isinstance(items, Iterator): items = list(items)` before building the closure and hash), and the code does not do that.
findings.evidence: Probe /home/runner/work/_temp/autose/review-scratch/probe_one_of.py: issue example => [{'tag': 'a'}]; direct calls => [True, False, False]; AC-4 => [{'tag': 'b'}]; reuse => ([{'tag': 'a'}], [])
findings.suggested_fix: Materialise once before building the test, for example `if isinstance(items, Iterator): items = list(items)` at the top of one_of. Then keep `lambda value: value in items` and `freeze(items)` so the closure and the hash both use the materialised list.

findings.description: The hash/equality tuple still freezes the raw generator object. The query's identity therefore depends on the generator object rather than on the allowed values, which goes against C2/ADR-3: same-content generator queries compare unequal, and the hash does not describe the actual filter.
findings.evidence: Probe: `Query().tag.one_of(t for t in ['a']) == Query().tag.one_of(t for t in ['a'])` => False
findings.suggested_fix: Freeze the materialised list (this follows from the fix above).

findings.description: The generator test calls the query only once, so the exhaustion bug cannot show up, and it passes even though the behaviour is now worse. The issue's db.search scenario (several documents, a repeated value) is not tested, and neither are repeated direct calls, query reuse or hash equality.
findings.evidence: test_one_of_accepts_a_generator asserts only query({'tag': 'b'}) on a fresh query; the suite passes (230 passed) while the issue example returns [{'tag':'a'}].
findings.suggested_fix: Add tests for FR-QUERY-001.AC-1..AC-4 (db.search over [a,b,a,c] == [a,b,a]; three direct calls all True; a non-member gives False; order independence), FR-QUERY-003 (reuse across two searches with an insert in between) and FR-QUERY-004 (empty generator), plus an equality/hash check for generator queries with the same contents.

findings.description: The type hint is still `list[Any]` and the docstring still says only 'list'. The design planned to widen the hint to Iterable[Any] and document that a generator is consumed once at construction. In addition, list(items) on every call copies lists and sets for each document, an O(n) cost per document that was not there before.
findings.evidence: queries.py:476 `def one_of(self, items: list[Any])`; queries.py:487 `list(items)` inside the per-document lambda.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the type hint and docstring as the design describes. Materialising once removes the per-call copy.
